material_findings: TEPA's narrow same-key stale-memory revocation mechanism is clearly specified and supported by strong matched primary-study evidence, but no author-linked executable bundle or protocol-matched independent rerun was found.
Published run constants permit rough pooled-count reconstruction, but not paired CIs/permutation tests without raw paired outcomes.

Displayed controlled-reversal rates 0.309 and 0.210 imply MPI about 0.3204 under the paper's stated formula, not the reported 0.318; other displayed rate/difference pairs also differ by 0.001, so exact statistical reconstruction requires raw/pre-rounding outputs.
Do not generalize this result to open-ended semantic contradiction detection, multi-hop retrieval, long-context selection, or autonomous-science memory improvement.
blocker: No public executable/raw-output bundle or protocol-matched third-party reproduction was found; exact benchmark/statistical replay is therefore blocked on artifact release or independent rerun.
